card.name: Small words inside lab and dosing phrases
card.fires_on: Small linking words, spaces or word parts in technical label text, such as the space before '4 hours' in dialysis removal, or 'in' and 'with' after a named lab test or material.

modes.label: Space before a duration
modes.description: The space token just before a number of hours in the hemodialysis removal sentence.
modes.example: removed by hemodialysis (23% of dose over<< >>4 hours)

modes.label: Link word after a test or material
modes.description: A short word like in, with or a that follows a named assay, test or tubing and leads into the patient group or condition.
modes.example: using the Bio-Rad Laboratories Platelia Aspergillus EIA test<< in>> patients receiving piperacillin and t

modes.label: Inside a split word
modes.description: A piece partway through a word or abbreviation in an interference or compatibility passage.

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted and suppressed tokens look unrelated to the pattern.
